BL-945 — Architecture Rule 6 and two production source files cite docs/branding/icon-system.md as normative authority, but the file exists only on an unmerged branch and is unreadable from every agent worktree
What it solves: Source: found by the specifier on 2026-08-19 while draining the operator intake `backlog/INTAKE-epic-icon-pool-scale-up.md`. Surfaced as its own ticket rather than folded into the icon work, because it is independent of whatever the human decides about the pool: the citation is dangling either way.…
Approval context: One thing wants your judgement, and it is about the branch, not the check.
I have specced the fix as "land `docs/branding/icon-system.md` on main, document only, assets stay on the branch". That treats the constitution's existing citation as settling the question - the article already calls the doc…
BL-945 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-945" (or "reject BL-945 <reason>") to act.
